title: Owner Cockpit Browser Journey Matrix (PASS 40)
runsIn: owner-pilot-e2e CI lane (real app + seeded Postgres, one OWNER login)

journeys.name: normal — one top governed action
journeys.browserTest: A. normal: exactly one top governed action with why / owner-decision / reassessment
journeys.componentTest: A. normal: renders exactly one top action with why/decision/reassessment

journeys.name: crisis recovery — collapsed, no guarantee
assertions: no forbidden copy in the section
journeys.browserTest: B. crisis recovery: section is collapsed and expands to a no-guarantee caveat
journeys.componentTest: B. crisis recovery: section is collapsed and expands to a no-guarantee caveat

journeys.name: public signal — collapsed, no live ingestion
journeys.browserTest: C. public signal: section is collapsed, shows the no-live-ingestion boundary, hides raw text/PII
journeys.componentTest: C. public signal: section is collapsed, shows the no-live-ingestion boundary, hides raw text/PII

journeys.name: action controls — labelled, never prompt
assertions: SUBMIT_EVIDENCE blocked until an evidence ref is entered
journeys.browserTest: D. action controls: a reason action opens a labelled inline form, not window.prompt
journeys.componentTest: D. action controls: a reason action opens a labelled inline form, not window.prompt; D. SUBMIT_EVIDENCE cannot be submitted with no evidence reference

journeys.name: unauthorized — gate cannot be bypassed
assertions: GET /api/owner/public-signals returns non-200 without a session
journeys.browserTest: E. unauthorized: unauthenticated navigation is redirected and the owner API fails closed
journeys.componentTest: n/a (server-side gate; RBAC authenticated-403 covered by tests/browser/10-rbac-workspace.spec.ts + route capability enforcement)

journeys.name: clean workspace — one honest state, no fabrication
assertions: exactly one of owner-cockpit / cockpit-clean renders (never both, never a hybrid)
if clean: honest empty copy + zero top-action-title
component: bridge=null and empty-routes bridge → cockpit-clean, no invented action, sections collapsed
journeys.browserTest: F. the cockpit renders exactly one honest state (top action XOR clean), never a fabricated hybrid
journeys.componentTest: F. clean workspace: no top action is invented; honest empty state renders; F. an empty bridge (no routes) also renders the honest empty state

journeys.name: no-overload limits
assertions: secondary/monitor/proof (+recovery/signals in component) all collapsed by default
journeys.browserTest: G. no-overload: ≤1 top action, ≤3 reason bullets, ≤2 primary, ≤3 secondary, every section collapsed
journeys.componentTest: G. no-overload: 1 top action, ≤3 reason bullets, ≤2 primary, ≤3 secondary, every section collapsed
